zh.name: 鞋履手持与细节特写
zh.summary: 用手持近景拍清鞋底、鞋面和走线。
zh.useWhen: 适合靠鞋底、走线或材料细节体现卖点的鞋款。
zh.instructions: 上传手持鞋照和鞋底鞋面特写，填写卖点。
zh.output: 鞋履近景和工艺细节图。

en.name: Handheld Shoes and Detail Close-ups
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about handheld Shoes and Detail Close-ups.
en.useWhen: For footwear with distinctive soles, stitching, or materials.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with handheld Shoes and Detail Close-ups.
